comment: 5 edge-case signal variants for the EIME NBA crew. Each names the expected crew behavior.

fixtures.name: happy_path_recurring_post
fixtures.expected: Sensor passes; Arbiter picks post_je_now; consumer=human_card Delegate on treasurer_dashboard.

fixtures.name: cooldown_suppression
fixtures.expected: Sensor suppresses — same je_id evaluated 2m ago, within 5m cooldown.

fixtures.name: conflicting_projections
fixtures.expected: Arbiter must arbitrate — post_je_now saves toil but raises cash_timing_impact while route_to_approval lowers SLA risk; spread > 0.10 so no escalation.

fixtures.name: irreversible_top_candidate_escalation
fixtures.expected: Top candidate is recommend_budget_reallocation (human_only, harm axis non-zero) -> escalate=true, consumer=human_card Analyze on cabinet.

fixtures.name: insufficient_context_defer
fixtures.expected: Recommender defers — trigger lacks confidence + tolerance fields to project; emits request_human_review rather than guessing.
